title: PG Hunt
player_goal: Sign a PG before the hotel's three nights run out.
design_goal: Hurdles with Indian texture; teach negotiation (offer / counter / walk) on three temperaments; introduce the food meter; end on the first homesick beat.

cast.role: 'Full, full — pay token.' Firm haggler; takes the token and vanishes (unlessFlag pg_token_paid)
Warns before, consoles after; points to Shanthamma
Veg-only, gate at ten, honest. Warm haggler: moved by reasons, insulted by lowballs
Slick haggler: drops to the floor when you leave — and the floor is still out of reach

beats.what: Walk off the east end of the Whitefield street into Prashanth Layout. Divya's call already pointed here.
Green gate: 'full, pay ₹1,000 token'. Haggle (firm) or refuse. Paying = he leaves for good; Leela Aunty explains the scam (−₹500–1,000, +lesson XP). Refusing = +2 local reputation.
HiveNest co-living: ₹62,000 to move in. Every counter-offer works and it is still unaffordable — even the 'festive offer' floor (₹43,000).
Shanthamma, blue gate no. 10: ₹10,000 deposit + ₹8,000 rent. Reasons move her, the green-gate quote helps, a lowball offends. Deal ≈ ₹14,000.
beats.reroute: walk away → price kept, come back any time

beats.what: Darshini or provision store: buy food. The food meter now drains while awake.
Room: cot under the window. Amma calls — 'Eat properly.' No choice, 15 seconds. Then sleep.

assets_needed: gate owner, Leela, Rhea, Raju, Basavaraj sheets (T-022 — tinted placeholders for now)
acceptance: walking off the east end of Whitefield's top pavement enters Prashanth Layout and ticks 'Find Prashanth Layout'
the green-gate owner haggles ₹1,000 → ₹500 at best; paying makes him leave, and Leela Aunty then explains the scam
Shanthamma's bill starts at ₹18,000, drops with reasons, holds at her floor, takes offence at ₹2,000
HiveNest's 'Sign up' choice stays locked with 'Needs ₹…' at every price
the blue gate says it is locked until the deal is paid, then leads into the room
buying food on the lane raises the food meter; food drains while awake and hunger slows the walk
the cot plays Amma's call once, then sleeps
